title: Sage physics_material record
description: A physics_material record (PhysicsMaterialRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another physics_material record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

friction.description: 0 slides like ice; a body's own friction wins over it. Range: 0 to 2. Category: Physics. (float, default 0.7)

restitution.description: Bounciness: 0 stops dead, 1 bounces back as fast. Range: 0 to 1. Category: Physics. (float, default 0)

footstep.description: The cue a footstep on it raises (its sound, its dust) Names a cue record. Category: Effects. (RecordId)

land.description: The cue landing on it from a fall or a jump raises; empty = its footstep. Names a cue record. Category: Effects. (RecordId)

jump.description: The cue jumping off it raises; empty = its footstep. Names a cue record. Category: Effects. (RecordId)

impact.description: The cue a blow or a shot that lands on it raises. Names a cue record. Category: Effects. (RecordId)

decal.description: What a bullet hole in it looks like (a hint for the weapon code) A texture path. Category: Effects. (AssetPath)

penetration.description: How hard it is to shoot through, per metre: 0 never stops a round, 1 is the reference (brick); a hint for hitscan. At least 0. Category: Effects. (float, default 1)

textures.description: The brush textures it covers: a name, or a pattern with * ("wood*"); case does not matter. Category: Brushes. (List<string>)

textures+.description: Adds to "textures": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

textures-.description: Removes these from "textures" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
